#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

using LL = long long;
using ULL = unsigned long long;

const int P1 = 998244353;
const int P2 = 1e9 + 7;
const int half = 1000000;

inline int mod(LL x, int P) {
    x %= P;
    return x < 0 ? x + P : x;
}

const int pow10[] = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000, 10000000, 100000000};

int ans, tot1;
LL n, tot2;
LL s[10];
vector<int> vec[10];

void init(int x, int v) {
    if (x > 6) return;
    vec[x].push_back(mod(tot1 - v, P1));
    s[x] += mod(tot1++ - v, P1);
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) init(x + 1, v * 10 + i);
}

inline bool check(LL x) {
    return x * half + half - 1 <= n && x * half * 10 > n;
}

void solve(int x, LL v) {
    if (v > n) return;
    if (check(v)) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
            int t = mod(tot2 + 1 - v * pow10[i], P1);
            int loc = lower_bound(vec[i].begin(), vec[i].end(), P1 - t) - vec[i].begin();
            ans = mod(ans + s[i] + 1LL * t * vec[i].size() - 1LL * P1 * (vec[i].size() - loc), P2);
        }
        tot2 += tot1;
    } else {
        ans = mod(ans + mod(++tot2 - v, P1), P2);
        for (int i = (!x); i < 10; ++i) solve(x + 1, v * 10 + i);
    }
}

int main() {
    cin >> n;
    init(0, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) sort(vec[i].begin(), vec[i].end());
    tot2 = -1;
    solve(0, 0);
    cout << ans;
    return 0;
}

    x %= P;
    return x < 0 ? x + P : x;
}

const int pow10[] = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000, 10000000, 100000000};

int ans, total1;
LL n, total2;
LL sum[10];
vector<int> data[10];

void build(int depth, LL val) {
    if (depth > 6) return;
    data[depth].push_back(mod(total1 - val, P1));
    sum[depth] += mod(total1++ - val, P1);
    for (int d = 0; d < 10; ++d) build(depth + 1, val * 10 + d);

bool condition(LL x) {
    return x * half + half - 1 <= n && x * half * 10 > n;
}

void traverse(int depth, LL val) {
    if (val > n) return;
    if (condition(val)) {
        for (int i = 6; i >= 0; --i) {
            int t = mod(total2 + 1 - val * pow10[i], P1);
            int loc = upper_bound(data[i].begin(), data[i].end(), P1 - t - 1) - data[i].begin();
            ans = mod(ans + sum[i] + 1LL * t * data[i].size() - 1LL * P1 * (data[i].size() - loc), P2);

        total2 += total1;

        ans = mod(ans + mod(++total2 - val, P1), P2);
        for (int d = (depth == 0 ? 1 : 0); d < 10; ++d) traverse(depth + 1, val * 10 + d);
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cin >> n;
    build(0, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) sort(data[i].begin(), data[i].end());
